title: publish-release.sh discards the qualification-report download's stderr, so a failure there cannot say why
description: On the 0.9.1 publish (2026-09-24), the first run of scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.1 35953824422 died with 'could not download the qualification reports' before any registry write. The download at scripts/publish-release.sh:329-330 redirects >/dev/null 2>&1, so the cause was lost. The identical gh run download by hand moments later exited 0 with 18 files, and the retry published. A redirected stderr cannot report its own breakage (fleet operating block, Tools). Capture stderr and print it in the die message; consider one bounded retry, since this is a read before any write.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A failing qualification-report download prints gh's own error text in the die message
Proven with a deliberately failing download (e.g. a bogus run id) showing the gh error, and a passing one unchanged

plan: Capture gh run download stderr in verify_platform_digests and include it in the die message
Add one bounded retry (a read before any write)
Tests: a download failing on both attempts shows gh error text; failing once then succeeding proceeds
Ship in the same PR as LCLI-578
implementationNotes: IMPLEMENTED alongside LCLI-578 on feat/LCLI-578-qualification-receipt-gate. verify_platform_digests now captures gh run download's stderr to a temp file and prints it in the die message ('... (2 attempts). gh said: <text>'). It retries ONCE after REPORT_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS (default 5), emptying the download dir between attempts. Tests: always-failing stub -> die message carries the stub's HTTP 502 text, and exactly 2 attempts are counted; fail-once stub -> proceeds to 6/6 verified. Mutation: removing the retry, or restoring 2>/dev/null, turned exactly those two tests red. Not re-measured against a real gh failure. The real 0.9.3 dry-run exercised only the success path.

Closing evidence, re-measured by the dispatching session 2026-09-25 against head 6f6eaf54 with real gh: publish-release.sh 0.9.3 99999999999 --dry-run (artifacts pre-populated so only the report download could fail) printed attempt 1's gh error 'error fetching artifacts: HTTP 404: Not Found (https://api.github.com/repos/opum-ai/lore-cli/actions/runs/99999999999/artifacts?per_page=100)', retried once after 5s, and died quoting the same text; exit 1, zero npm calls. The passing case is unchanged: the 0.9.3 run 36088480940 dry-run downloaded all reports and verified 6 platform digests. Stubbed tests also pin the retry's directory cleanup (a partial first attempt then success), proven by mutation.
finalSummary: The qualification-report download in publish-release.sh no longer discards stderr. gh's own error is printed per attempt and quoted in the die message, and the download retries once (a bounded 2 attempts, REPORT_RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS default 5 s, the same timing-override pattern the script already uses). The report directory is emptied between attempts, so a partial first attempt cannot leave an ambiguous second match. Verified with real gh against a bogus run id (HTTP 404 text surfaced, exit 1), the passing 0.9.3 run unchanged, and stubbed tests for fail-twice, fail-once-then-succeed and partial-first-attempt, each proven by mutation. Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#269 alongside LCLI-578.
